description: Closed-form symbolic q-rational expression for tr_M(β_EW Δ_I^minimal) at H_6, computed via iterative Hecke quadratic + braid-relation reduction + Markov peel. Implements the bring_top_together algorithm diagnosed as missing in docs/audits/2026-05-18-symbolic-trM-H6-partial.md (the gap that forces tr_M_element to punt to the numeric-only Ocneanu fallback). The full symbolic tr_M is a pure-q rational function (size ~24k chars unsimplified); numerical evaluation at q_0 matches the float64 Wenzl-bridge value 3.4187800525 to 12 decimal digits, confirming the symbolic derivation. Simplification + structural inspection (does z = z_markov, ℏ_q, or some categorical scale appear?) is the next step in a separate probe.
caveats: Expression is unsimplified (~24k chars). Running sp.cancel/sp.factor for closed-form display is the next step. The bring_top_together algorithm is documented in this file's docstring; mainstreaming it into hecke_laurent_fast.reduce_laurent_rules is recommended follow-up.
